parent_objective: audit M2362 measured-execution artifact before any repair, ranking, or paper-route interpretation
blocked_by: M2362 measured execution is complete but outcome interpretation is deferred to audit
M2362 global outcome is offtrack-dominated and requires slice localization before repair
supersedes: ranking profiles from raw M2362 aggregates
repairing offtrack failures before auditing outcome slices

public_gates: M2363 must audit M2362 summary, episode denominator, metadata completeness, and claim boundary without rerun
M2363 must summarize global and pack/profile/role outcome slices
M2363 must choose a bounded next route without ranking, winner selection, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, or level3 self-ID claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the first complete closed-loop measured panel over the reset-valid repaired five-pack scenario family
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if M2362 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if outcome slices cannot localize the dominant failure mode
stop if audit attempts to rank profiles or claim paper verdict
stop if next route is not bounded
fallback_plan: route to runner/metric repair if artifacts are inconsistent
route to outcome-slice localization if offtrack or collision dominates
route to branch synthesis if measured evidence is sufficient to choose a larger route

allowed_updates: M2363 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2362 artifacts are accepted or rejected
dominant failure mode and actionable slices are summarized
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2363 audits measured outcomes but does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2363; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Weak outcomes should be classified by role/pack/profile slices before repair.
allowed_claims: measured-execution result audit and route selection
no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits a new 5400-episode measured closed-loop artifact
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can route to outcome localization or repair design but cannot establish paper verdict by itself
must_synthesize_if: M2363 cannot choose a next route from the measured artifact
M2363 proposes direct ranking or paper conclusion
the measured-execution branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2362 measured-execution artifacts can identify the dominant failure mode and choose a bounded next route without ranking or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: M2362 denominator and metadata gates are audited
global and slice outcome summaries are recorded
ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2363 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2363 ranks support policies or controller families
M2363 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2363 cannot decide next route from complete artifacts

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2362 measured-execution artifacts

decision_rule: M2363 passes if it audits the complete measured artifact and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
